TPS offers temporary relief for individuals whose home countries face severe challenges like natural disasters or political unrest. While it provides work permits and legal protections, it’s not a permanent solution and can be revoked at any time. If you’re a TPS recipient, it’s crucial to explore additional pathways like asylum to ensure your long-term security in the U.S. Don’t let uncertainty define your future—learn how to secure your rights.
